set.body: Found on 2026-09-26 by CR2, UI-G G1 and UI-G G2. io DiagnosticCoverageJvmSuite reads the COMMITTED tools/api-audit/inventory.json, but tools/api-audit/run.py --record runs every module's tests before it writes the inventory. So a branch that adds a public error enum can't pass: (a) run testAll first and the suite passes against a stale inventory, so the branch lands red (G1 did, and needed hotfix 7ba03d1); (b) record first and run.py fails in the coverage suite's 'every sampled family is a public enum of the inventory' check and never records (G2). Builders work around it with a never-committed bootstrap exemption and a second run. Fix: run.py writes the candidate inventory (from compiled TASTy) to target/api-audit BEFORE running tests, and DiagnosticCoverageJvmSuite reads that candidate when present, falling back to the committed file only outside an audit run. Alternatively, make the coverage checks part of check.py. Acceptance: a branch adding an error enum plus Diagnose samples passes 'run.py --record' in one pass, and one missing its Diagnose fails both run.py and testAll; update AGENTS.md 'Landing a branch' and remove the ordering caveat.
set.title: Break the audit/coverage circularity: DiagnosticCoverage must read the candidate inventory
